name: Reflection Beam 1.0 (501B-A23B)
access: Hugging Face weights (reflection/Beam-1.0-501B-A23B in BF16; FP8 and NVFP4 in separate repositories; DFlash2 drafter for speculative decoding)
Reflection API (public beta; OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions at api.reflection.ai/openai/v1)
Amazon SageMaker AI and Google Cloud Model Garden (the developer docs list Microsoft Foundry and Oracle as coming soon; the availability post lists both at launch)
other inference providers named by Reflection, including Baseten, Cloudflare, CoreWeave, Databricks, Fireworks AI, Modal, Nebius, Ollama, Together AI and Vercel

pricing_usd_per_mtok.notes: Reflection publishes no per-token list price; its availability post calls its own API a public beta that is free to start. OpenRouter (a reseller, class A) lists five providers at 0.25 to 0.40 input, 1.00 to 1.20 output and 0.04 to 0.05 cache read per million tokens (Nebius has the lowest input price, 0.25, with 1.00 output and 0.05 cache read); Artificial Analysis uses 0.40 input and 1.20 output. Self-hosting has no per-token price

unknown: SWE-Bench Pro (Scale, public V2): no Beam row found on Scale's leaderboard page read 2026-10-31; Reflection's own SWE Bench Pro v1 and v2-Hard figures are maker runs, and Scale says it co-developed V2 with Reflection
METR 50% time horizon: no Beam entry; METR's page says it is no longer actively updated (last updated 2026-09-08)
pricing_usd_per_mtok: input, output and cached_input: Reflection publishes no list price (read 2026-10-31); the reseller range is in the notes
max_output: 131,072 is the Reflection API's figure (128K in its model table); the default output budget is 32,768 and a plan's per-request limit can be lower
reasoning.default: the API documentation shows max as the example default and says the default can differ between organizations; the self-hosted chat template defaults to effort 512, its max

released: 2026-10-16 is the open-weight and public-beta date and Artificial Analysis's release date; Reflection announced Beam on 2026-10-05 with waitlist access, and its model list gives 2026-10-05 as the created date
status: the weights are released under Apache-2.0; Reflection's own API is still a public beta
Terminal-Bench 4.0: no row was read on the tbench.ai leaderboard; the score is Artificial Analysis's run
system_card: the Beam Safety Technical Report is a web page; the model card still lists a technical report as coming
generation: Reflection numbers the release 1.0; no earlier Beam generation exists
